title: The lead agent made Home's default by the owner's decision, with the build path fixed under it and the rules-first Home kept as the fallback
request: The owner, after the three-arm practice exam: use the lead agent in the DCLab R&D project; offered a local switch in make dev or the default for everyone, the owner chose the default, knowing both sealed exams failed their gates.
spec: The lead agent leads Home wherever a model serves its purpose; DCLAB_CASE_AGENT=0 turns it off; with no model the rules-first Home serves; nothing that measures today's Home changes what it measures.
plan: Find every place the switch is read
Make the default depend on a model serving the purpose, keep the explicit switch
Keep the rules-first Home callable by name for the fallback and the exam
Test the switch, the default with and without a model, and the exam arm
One live turn through the product's path, review, gate, commit

decisions.decision: The default is on only where a model serves case_agent
decisions.why: with no model (tests, the open edition, DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS) the lead agent cannot run; the rules-first Home stays their path

decisions.decision: DCLAB_CASE_AGENT=0 turns it off in one line; 1 still forces it on
decisions.why: the owner overrode an unpassed gate, so going back must be one change

decisions.decision: The rules-first Home becomes DraftWork.rules_first and the exam's arm home calls it by name
decisions.why: the arm built Home through DraftWork.agent; with the new default it would have become the lead agent and the exam would compare the lead agent with itself

decisions.decision: The old prompts are kept, not retired
decisions.why: the plan retires them at switch-on, but they are the fallback while the gate has not passed

change: dclab_rnd/agents/case_agent.py (on(models) with the default); dclab_rnd/draft/work.py (agent uses on(self.models), rules_first); dclab_rnd/agent_eval/conversation_exam/arms.py (HomeArm uses rules_first); docstrings in case_home.py and harness.py; docs/guides/PHASE13_CLAUDE_FIRST_PLAN.md (37.11 status); tests/test_case_home.py; dclab_rnd/draft/case_home.py (build after the yes, build answers read by code, confirm moment, turn lock, segmentation family); dclab_rnd/draft/api.py (rule tags on the outcome and moment refusals); dclab_rnd/draft/work.py (clients and on_request for CaseHome, a draft keeps its Home); .env.example

findings.defect: The exam's arm home would have become the lead agent
findings.scenario: make the default on, run the conversation exam with the arms home and case on a live key: both arms are the lead agent
findings.cause: HomeArm built Home with DraftWork.agent, the product's wiring, which now gives the lead agent by default

findings.defect: With the lead agent leading Home, a prediction draft could not be built
findings.scenario: the person says yes, presses Build: 409 on the outcome, a column question answered by the agent, the build refused again in a loop
findings.cause: CaseHome had no on_request; its build yes was stored in case_state.build, which nothing read; quick_build's needs were never written
findings.fix: CaseHome starts the build after the yes (on_request, built); the build's outcome and moment questions are read by code; a column check goes to take_answer

findings.defect: A draft started under the rules-first Home lost its history under the lead agent
findings.scenario: three rules answers, then the default flips: the agent sees only the last message
findings.fix: a draft keeps the Home that started it (_lead_agent_may_lead)

findings.defect: Any sentence became the prediction moment and started a build
findings.scenario: 'What do you mean by prediction moment?' saved as the moment and built
findings.cause: the first fix took any 8+ characters
findings.fix: no '?'; the moment is said back and built only on a short yes; a 'yes, but' correction is said back again

findings.defect: A column named in passing became the outcome
findings.scenario: 'Actually I just want revenue by region' made region the target
findings.fix: only a message that is a column name or 'the outcome is <column>'

findings.defect: A build question stayed open after the route moved on, a second yes built nothing, the lead agent's turns held no lock, and groups kept their family after a prediction
findings.scenario: route to analysis then 'revenue by region'; a refused build then yes again; two instances; groups then 'predict churn'
findings.cause: build_waiting cleared in two places only; state.build compared by value; no @turn; family never removed
findings.fix: cleared on a route change and a new table; state.build reset each turn; @turn on start, reply, data_ready; family removed when the route leaves segmentation
findings.test: tests/test_case_home.py (route, second yes, turn lock, groups tests)

findings.defect: The agent said 'nothing is built yet' as the build started
findings.scenario: live check e2e-1: the project was created right after that sentence
findings.fix: 'the build starts now; give no result or number before it has run'

measurements.name: one live Home turn through DraftWork with DCLAB_CASE_AGENT unset and the Claude key in .env
measurements.gate: the default gives the lead agent (CaseHome) and it answers the first message within a cap of EUR 0.3
measurements.result: CaseHome served; it asked for a table of past cancellations with attendance, membership type and start date; EUR 0.02
limits: one opening only; it says nothing about the route, which is the lead agent's known weak point

measurements.name: live: Home led by the lead agent through the real app, bank_marketing sample, a scripted person, from the first sentence to a built project
measurements.gate: a project is built from the chat after the person's yes, with duration kept out, within a cap of EUR 0.3
measurements.result: project built from the chat; the agent read target as the outcome and kept duration out because it is known only after the call; EUR 0.08
limits: one person, one table; the outcome and moment came from the sample's own suggestion, so the build questions were not asked live

outcome: Home's conversation is the lead agent's by default wherever a model serves it, with the rules-first Home as the fallback, one line to turn it off, and the exam still measuring today's Home. The sealed gate has not passed: the route is the known risk.
lessons: Before flipping a default, find every caller that reaches it through the shared wiring, evaluations first
A switch an owner overrides keeps a one-line way back
A new default path needs the end-to-end action (here a build) tested before it is turned on, not only the conversation
risks: The route: 0.79 against Claude alone's 1.00 on sealed v2; the advice-door fix is measured on practice people only
Replies are slower (about 16 s against 12) and cost about EUR 0.09 a conversation on practice people
